critique: The render has the essential black-background, mint-to-neon-green triangular particle look, and frame 4 visibly has more particles than frame 1. However, it reads as a small, dense pile of overlapping triangles near the center rather than a clear 2D motion-graphics triangle field. The very low particle velocity keeps the animation compressed, obscuring individual triangle shapes and making the motion feel like accumulation rather than an energetic expanding arrangement.

suggestions.why: Increase emitter velocity so particles separate into individually readable triangles and create the broader, more graphic motion expected from the preset.
Widen directional spread along with the increased velocity, preventing the particles from remaining a tight central clump.
